add_noise_distribution — 2D noise op

• Data kinds: image → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "add_noise_distribution", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: add_noise_distribution (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Adds additive noise to the image. The implementation supports only Gaussian (normal-distribution) noise, sharing the `gaussian branch of _sh_noise with add_noise_white. The random numbers are generated with a fixed seed determined by a (int(a*997)+7`), so the same a always produces the same noise (deterministic). b sets the noise standard deviation to 0.02-0.22.
